title_en: Wang Xinming — Speculation and Profiteering Case
keywords_en: criminal; speculation; first instance; primary people's court; Shandong Province; natural person; criminal law; determination of directly responsible persons in unit speculation; whether failure to line one's own pockets affects conviction; partial support; illegal sale of gold; illegal resale of potassium gold cyanide; enterprise legal representative acting on own authority
full_text_en:
Wang Xinming — crime of speculation

Defendant: Wang Xinming, male, 40 years old, former director of Haiyang County Radio Component Factory, Shandong Province.

The case of defendant Wang Xinming for speculation was initiated by the Haiyang County People's Procuratorate, Shandong Province, by filing a public prosecution with the Haiyang County People's Court. The court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and, after a public trial, found the following:

The gold potassium cyanide required by the Haiyang County Radio Component Factory in its production process was allocated by the state. The gold potassium cyanide lost in the waste residue during production was recovered by the factory and refined into gold, which, in accordance with the provisions of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Gold and Silver, was to be sold to the Haiyang County Branch of the People's Bank of China.

In March 1988, the defendant Wang Xinming, violating the Regulations on the Administration of Gold and Silver, made unauthorized decisions and on four occasions sold 4,606.5 grams of gold refined by the factory to Jinan Qilu Gold Shop at RMB 73.54 per gram, receiving a total of RMB 338,739.75, with an illegal profit of RMB 161,683.75 (this amount represents the difference from the price that should have been obtained if sold to the People's Bank of China as required).

From December 1988 to January 1989, the defendant Wang Xinming, acting on his own authority, on three occasions sold 3,500 grams of gold potassium cyanide allocated by the state to the factory to Yantai Xingguang United Precious Metal Electroplating Company, receiving a total of RMB 199,500, with an illegal profit of RMB 46,620.

Wang Xinming's illegal sales of gold and gold potassium cyanide amounted to a total business volume of RMB 538,239.75 and an illegal profit of RMB 208,303.75. This illegal income was all recorded in the financial accounts of Haiyang County Radio Component Factory and was primarily used for purchasing raw materials, covering losses, and buying one passenger car. After the case was discovered, RMB 10,837.15 in illicit money and one passenger car were recovered from Haiyang County Radio Component Factory.

The above facts are confirmed by witness testimony.

The Haiyang County People's Court found upon trial that: Haiyang County Radio Component Factory violated the provisions of the Regulations on the Administration of Gold and Silver by illegally selling gold, with an especially large amount, seriously undermining the socialist economic order. Pursuant to the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Current Handling of Criminal Cases of Speculation by Enterprises, Institutions, State Organs, and Organizations, criminal liability shall be investigated against the persons directly in charge and the persons directly responsible. The defendant Wang Xinming was the legal representative of Haiyang County Radio Component Factory. In the activities of the factory's illegal sale of gold, he both made unauthorized decisions and personally delivered the gold to Qilu Gold Shop for sale, thus being the person directly in charge and the person directly responsible. Although he did not line his own pockets, his conduct constituted the crime of speculation under Article 117 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and shall be punished according to law. Considering the facts and circumstances of the defendant Wang Xinming's crime, a suspended sentence would not cause further harm to society, and a suspended sentence may be pronounced pursuant to Article 67 of the Criminal Law. Pursuant to Article 60 of the Criminal Law and the Provisions on the Current Handling of Criminal Cases of Speculation by Enterprises, Institutions, State Organs, and Organizations, all property obtained by the entity through speculation shall be recovered. Accordingly, the Haiyang County People's Court on January 23, 1990, rendered the following judgment:

The defendant Wang Xinming is convicted of the crime of speculation and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year and six months, with a two-year suspension of the sentence.
